concerns.text: FR-005 ('System MUST generate a convergence plot showing FTLE estimates vs. time window for at least three distinct noise levels') is not anchored to any User Story. US-1 covers generation, US-2 covers calculation, and US-3 covers regression/visualization of deviation scaling. A convergence plot for multiple noise levels is a specific visualization not explicitly covered by the scope of US-3 (which focuses on deviation vs. noise amplitude and dimension scaling). This is an orphaned requirement.

FR-007 ('System MUST flag trajectories where σ_noise > 0.1...') references 'See Edge Cases' but the Edge Cases section describes a threshold of σ_noise > 1.0 for leaving the attractor. The FR introduces a new, stricter threshold (0.1) and a specific 'high-noise regime' flagging behavior that is not present in the Edge Cases or any User Story. This creates a scope mismatch and an unanchored requirement.

SC-004 ('The computational runtime... is measured against the specified CI limit, targeting completion within a reasonable timeframe') is not anchored to a specific User Story. While US-1 mentions a 30-second limit for generation, SC-004 refers to the 'full analysis pipeline' (generation + calculation + regression). No User Story explicitly defines the acceptance criteria for the total pipeline runtime or a 'CI limit'. This is an orphaned success criterion.
